map.教育学习类工具给出的成绩、GPA、时长、排名等均为按公式得到的估算值，不能替代学: Scores, GPA, durations and rankings from education tools are formula-based estimates and do not replace school teaching, teacher assessment or official exam standards; follow textbooks, examination authorities and school rules.
map.任务、科目与统计仅保存在本机浏览器 localStorage，清理缓存或更换设备: Tasks, subjects and statistics live only in this browser's localStorage; clearing the cache or switching devices does not sync them, so export important plans as backups.
map.完成率怎么算？: How is the completion rate calculated?
map.已完成任务数 ÷ 当前任务总数 × 100%；任务列表为空时显示「—」，避免除零: Done tasks ÷ current total tasks × 100%; it shows “—” when the list is empty to avoid division by zero.
map.进度复盘：完成率 = 已完成任务 ÷ 任务总数，待办计划分钟提示剩余工作量。: Progress review: completion rate = done tasks ÷ total tasks; pending planned minutes show the remaining workload.
map.按科目难度²加权分配每日/每周学习时长；今日任务支持高/中/低优先级并自动排序，: Allocate daily/weekly study time by subject difficulty squared; today's tasks support high/medium/low priority and auto-sort, accumulating subject time when checked off; the stats page shows completion rate and planned minutes remaining.
map.备考分配：把每日总时长按科目难度²加权拆分，难科目自动拿到更多时间。: Exam prep allocation: split daily total time by difficulty squared so harder subjects automatically get more time.
map.今日任务：任务带高/中/低优先级，列表按高→中→低排序，完成后自动累计科目时长。: Today's tasks: high/medium/low priority, sorted high→medium→low, automatically accumulating subject time when completed.
map.权重取难度平方：1–5 星对应权重 1–25，难度 5 的科目拿 25 份，难度: Weights use difficulty squared: 1–5 stars map to weights 1–25; a difficulty-5 subject gets 25 shares while difficulty-3 gets only 9, so harder subjects receive noticeably more time.
